sources_used: sec-data/cat1-us/10K/2026/IP_2026-02-27.htm.gz (FY24, FY25 - DS Smith integration + recast PS NA/PS EMEA segments)
_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: Net Sales total (impact transformatif DS Smith 2025), Industrial Packaging legacy (cle 2021-2024), PS NA recast (post-DS Smith), PS EMEA (nouveau via DS Smith), Adjusted EBITDA (rentabilite post-deal). Segments recast en 2025 suite a combinaison DS Smith.

kpis.signal: Saut 2025 reflete consolidation DS Smith (closing fin 2024), nouvelle taille IP en packaging mondial
kpis.description_fr: CA total operations continues. Saut 2025 +49% reflete combinaison DS Smith (closing fin janvier 2025). Recasts retraitent GCF en operations discontinues a partir 2023.
kpis.description_en: Total net sales continuing operations. 2025 +49% jump reflects DS Smith combination (closed late Jan 2025). Recasts treat GCF as discontinued operations from 2023.

kpis.signal: Segment legacy historique IP (containerboard + corrugated boxes Amerique Nord), supprime 2025 au profit PS NA/PS EMEA
kpis.description_fr: CA Industrial Packaging legacy (North American Container + EMEA Packaging). Segment principal historique, demantele 2025 suite combinaison DS Smith en PS NA et PS EMEA.
kpis.description_en: Industrial Packaging legacy revenue (North American Container + EMEA Packaging). Historical main segment, restructured 2025 post-DS Smith into PS NA and PS EMEA.
kpis._specific_to: IP legacy corrugated packaging pre-DS Smith

kpis.signal: Nouveau segment principal post-DS Smith, integration containerboard + corrugated boxes US incluant DS Smith NA
kpis.description_fr: CA Packaging Solutions North America (PS NA). Nouveau segment 2025 incluant legacy North American Container + DS Smith NA. 611 M$ apport DS Smith en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Packaging Solutions North America revenue (PS NA). New 2025 segment combining legacy North American Container + DS Smith NA. DS Smith contributed $611M in 2025.
kpis._specific_to: IP core US corrugated packaging post-merger

kpis.signal: Premier reporting Adjusted EBITDA 2025 (nouvelle metric management post-DS Smith), 2.98 Mds $ baseline post-deal
kpis.description_fr: Adjusted EBITDA operations continues (nouvelle metric introduite 2025). 2.98 Mds $ refletent IP+DS Smith. Cle pour suivre synergies $600M ciblees du deal.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted EBITDA continuing operations (new metric introduced 2025). $2.98B reflects IP+DS Smith combined. Key for tracking $600M targeted deal synergies.

kpis.signal: FCF negatif 2025 vs +757 M$ 2024, capex eleve 1.86 Mds $ pour integration DS Smith + transformation
kpis.description_fr: Free Cash Flow (cash operations - capex). Baisse spectaculaire 2025 a -159 M$ vs +757 M$ 2024 due capex 1.86 Mds $ (vs 921 M$ 2024) pour transformation et integration DS Smith.
kpis.description_en: Free Cash Flow (operating cash - capex). Sharp 2025 decline to -$159M vs +$757M 2024 due to $1.86B capex (vs $921M 2024) for transformation and DS Smith integration.
kpis._specific_to: IP transformation capex impact on FCF
